title: Tumhe WAITING, dalal ke paas CONFIRM kaise?
voice: ElevenLabs Bunty – Punchy, Crisp and Reel King (website, Eleven v4)
lines: [whispers] Ticket WAITING... kuli bola: confirm chahiye? Paanch sau extra!
Booking clerk khud kaat raha tha!
Master ji ne Aadhaar ke bahane phone liya... IRCTC ID bana li!
RPF ne pakda. Saza? Teen saal tak!
Aise aur railway raaz... follow karo!
caption:
Tumhara ticket WAITING me atka... aur station pe kisi ne dheere se bola: 'confirm chahiye? 500 extra.' Ye confirm ticket aata kahan se hai? 🚆🕵️

Asli case (Chhattisgarh, November 2026, RPF):
• Baradwar station ke reservation counter ka ek booking clerk WhatsApp pe aaye naamon ke ticket apne pad ka galat istemaal karke bana raha tha.
• Bilaspur station ka ek kuli deal karta tha: ticket ki photo WhatsApp pe, aur asli kiraye se ₹300-500 extra.
• Champa ke ek teacher ne ek gaon wale ka phone 'Aadhaar update' ke bahane liya aur bina bataye uske naam pe IRCTC ID bana li. Usi ID se e-ticket bana ke mehenge bechta tha.

RPF ne teeno ko pakda: 25 ticket, ₹1.16 lakh ke. Railways Act ki Section 143: bina authorisation ticket ka dhandha = 3 saal tak jail, ₹10,000 tak fine, ya dono.

Tip: apna phone aur OTP kisi ko mat do, aur ticket sirf IRCTC ya authorised agent se lo.

Kabhi kisi dalal ne tumse extra maanga hai? Comment karo 👇
